name: v_cloudflare_ai_bots
comment: Cloudflare Worker requests from AI crawlers, coding agents, and Markdown/llms.txt readers
statement:
FROM scopedb.public.cloudflare_worker_events
WHERE event_type = 'worker.invocation'
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    outcome,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    ray_id,
    attributes['wall_time_ms']::float AS wall_time_ms,
    attributes['cpu_time_ms']::float AS cpu_time_ms,
    attributes['user_agent']::string AS user_agent,
    attributes['accept']::string AS accept,
    attributes['referer_host']::string AS referer_host,
    attributes['country']::string AS country,
    attributes['as_organization']::string AS as_organization,
    attributes['verified_bot_category']::string AS verified_bot_category
WHERE path = '/llms.txt'
   OR ends_with(path, '.md')
   OR contains(accept, 'text/markdown')
   OR verified_bot_category IS NOT NULL
   OR regexp_like(
       user_agent,
       regex => '(?i)(ClaudeBot|Claude-Web|Claude-User|Anthropic|GPTBot|ChatGPT-User|OAI-SearchBot|Codex|Cursor|PerplexityBot|Perplexity-User|CCBot|Google-Extended|Applebot-Extended|Bytespider|Amazonbot|cohere-ai|YouBot)'
   )
